---
name: Bounded language increment
about: Propose one safe, testable experimental language or backend increment
title: "language: "
labels: language-design
---

## Problem and narrow proposed form

State the exact source or API form. Avoid combining unrelated syntax, runtime,
hardware, provider, and package work in one proposal.

## Required contract

Describe feature-gate stage, parser behavior, diagnostics, resolver behavior,
strict export behavior, simulator behavior, and explicit non-goals.

## Evidence plan

List the positive and negative smoke cases, CLI coverage where applicable, and
documentation records that would need updating. Do not claim a runtime or
hardware feature without a separately testable implementation plan.
